source_lineage_note: Only this job’s saved DCD segments are analyzed. Parent trajectories are preserved separately; carried parent observations are not counted as new frames.
limitations: Preparation trajectory, not production or an adsorption experiment.
Small-model fragment:* labels are internal prepared-residue numbers, not full-protein site assignments.
Contact threshold 0.45 nm; water double-proximity threshold 0.35 nm to each group; no hydrogen-bond angular criterion.
No contact lifetime, off-rate, adsorption free energy or material ranking inferred.
Plane-normal fitting uses short-preparation reference-image reconstruction; not a general long-time unwrapping method.
